title: Introduce the buying conversation
angle: Use the complete article to explain the Sony brief, the personal limit and the product direction.
gate: Approve article and verify the destination before CMS handoff.

title: Explain the preview
angle: Give returning readers the short account of what the preview demonstrates and what is planned next.
gate: Confirm preview release state and approve the entry.

title: Introduce Tix in motion
audience: Visitors to the intended entry surface
angle: Use the accepted short animation as the visual introduction.
gate: Creative approved. Login aspect ratio, crop, muted behavior and HTML CTA integration still require packaging.

title: Connect the product to the reader's work
audience: Opted-in leads, one mutually exclusive segment each
angle: Choose the SMB equipment, agency shoot or reseller evaluation variant from verified audience fields.
gate: Approve each variant, map a real audience and configure the ESP footer. Do not infer a partner program.

title: Write the buying brief
angle: Use the agency equipment example as a practical prompt readers can adapt.
gate: Approve the written post and linked destination.

title: Dinner with Tix
angle: Show the human moment that starts the buying conversation.
gate: The 55-second 1080p master is approved. Create and review a ≤30-second social version and platform crop before this placement.

title: Invite the first brief
audience: Eligible viewers who request the announcement
angle: Show the conversation graphic when the reader opens product updates.
gate: Approve graphic and copy. Bind to real targeting and respect dismissal; suppress people already enrolled.

title: What the price comparison means
angle: Explain the role of the buyer's own limit in the preview.
gate: Approve the exact post and destination.

title: Bring a real equipment need
audience: Verified returning preview readers; required customer labels are test contexts
angle: Use the SMB or agency exercise to help readers form their own request.
gate: Verify audience relationship before mapping customer segments. Suppress confirmed waitlist members from this acquisition CTA.

title: Ask what would change the decision
audience: Secondhand buyers with a current purchase in mind
angle: Invite specific buyer input about the details of a used-camera brief.
gate: Approve the exact post. Review replies manually.

title: Learn from the first response
angle: Review confirmed signups, source-tagged visits and the questions people ask. Use actual results to plan the next piece.
gate: No results or conversion targets are claimed. Collect evidence only after a real launch.
